about.title: About Sailing Academy
about.subtitle: Your gateway to water adventures on Herastrau Lake
about.storyText: Founded in 2021, Sailing Academy has been introducing Bucharest residents and visitors to the joys of water sports on Herastrau Lake. What started as a small kayak rental has grown into the premier water activities center in Bucharest, offering everything from quick rentals to professional sailing instruction.
about.missionText: We believe everyone should experience the peace and excitement of being on the water. Our mission is to make water sports accessible, safe, and enjoyable for all ages and skill levels.
about.why1Text: Located right next to the famous Herastrau Ferris Wheel, we're easy to find with ample parking nearby.
about.why2Text: Our fleet of kayaks, paddleboards, e-boats, and sailing vessels is maintained to the highest safety standards.
about.why3Text: Our certified sailing instructors and friendly staff are passionate about sharing their love of water sports.
about.why4Text: Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced sailor, we have activities suited to your level.
about.locationText: We're located at Șoseaua Nordului 7-9, right on the shores of Herastrau Lake, next to the iconic Ferris Wheel. Open daily from 9:30 to 20:00.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about water activities at Herastrau Lake

items.question: What can I do in Herastrau Park?
items.answer: Herastrau Park offers numerous activities including kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), electric boat rides, sailing, and sailing lessons at Sailing Academy. Located on Herastrau Lake, the park is perfect for water sports, cycling, walking, and enjoying nature in the heart of Bucharest.

items.question: Do I need a license to rent a boat in Bucharest?
items.answer: No license is required for our electric boats (e-boats), kayaks, or paddleboards at Sailing Academy. These are designed for recreational use and are easy to operate with no prior experience. For our sailing boats, beginners can rent with an instructor, while experienced sailors may sail independently.

items.question: Where can I kayak in Bucharest?
items.answer: The best place to kayak in Bucharest is Herastrau Lake at Sailing Academy. We offer single and double kayak rentals starting at 50 RON per hour, with all safety equipment included. Located near the Ferris Wheel, it's easy to find and offers beautiful lake views.

items.question: What water sports are available on Herastrau Lake?
items.answer: Herastrau Lake offers kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), electric boat cruises, and sailing at Sailing Academy. We provide equipment rental and lessons for all skill levels. The calm waters of the lake are perfect for beginners and families.

items.question: How much does it cost to rent a kayak in Bucharest?
items.answer: Kayak rental at Sailing Academy on Herastrau Lake costs 50 RON per hour for both single and double kayaks. This includes life jackets and basic instruction. Multi-hour discounts are available, and no reservation is required for walk-ins.

items.question: Is Sailing Academy open on weekends?
items.answer: Yes! Sailing Academy is open daily from 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM (20:00), including weekends and holidays during the season. Weekends are popular times, so arriving early or booking ahead via WhatsApp is recommended.

items.question: Can children go kayaking at Herastrau?
items.answer: Yes, children are welcome at Sailing Academy! Kids can paddle in double kayaks with adults, use appropriately-sized paddleboards, or enjoy family e-boat rides. Life jackets in all sizes are provided, and our staff ensures safety at all times.

services.title: Our Services
services.pageSubtitle: From quick rentals to sailing lessons - discover your perfect water adventure on Herastrau Lake

kayak.title: Kayak Rental
kayak.description: Single and double kayaks for lake exploration
kayak.heroSubtitle: Explore Herastrau Lake at your own pace
kayak.detailedDescription:
Kayaking on Herastrau Lake is one of the best ways to experience Bucharest's largest park from the water. Our kayak rental service offers well-maintained single and double kayaks perfect for couples, families, or solo explorers.

The calm waters of Herastrau Lake make it ideal for beginners, while experienced paddlers will enjoy the scenic route around the lake's islands and shores. All safety equipment is provided, and our team offers a brief introduction before you set off.
kayak.longDesc: Paddle your way around Herastrau Lake in our well-maintained kayaks. Perfect for couples, families, or solo adventurers looking to explore the calm waters at their own pace. All safety equipment included.

faq.question: Do I need kayaking experience?
faq.answer: No experience is required! Our team provides a quick safety briefing and paddling tips before you head out. The lake's calm waters are perfect for beginners.

faq.question: Can children use the kayaks?
faq.answer: Yes! Children can join adults in double kayaks. We provide child-sized life jackets for safety. Kids under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

faq.question: What if it rains?
faq.answer: Light rain is usually fine for kayaking. In case of storms or lightning, we'll postpone your rental or offer a refund. Safety is our priority.

sup.title: SUP Rental
sup.description: Stand-up paddleboards for all skill levels
sup.heroSubtitle: Find your balance on Herastrau Lake
sup.detailedDescription:
Stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) is one of the fastest-growing water sports, and Herastrau Lake provides the perfect setting to try it. Our stable, beginner-friendly boards make it easy for anyone to get started.

SUP offers a fantastic full-body workout while you enjoy the peaceful surroundings of the lake. Whether you want to work on your fitness, practice yoga on the water, or simply cruise around, paddleboarding is a rewarding experience for all ages.
sup.longDesc: Experience the lake from a new perspective on our stable paddleboards. Great workout and perfect for beginners. We provide a quick intro lesson before you head out.
sup.pricingSubtitle: Stand up and explore the lake

faq.question: Is SUP hard to learn?
faq.answer: Not at all! Most people can stand up and paddle within minutes. We start you on a wide, stable board and give you tips before you go. Falling in is part of the fun!

faq.question: What should I wear for paddleboarding?
faq.answer: Wear comfortable clothes that can get wet - swimwear, shorts, or athletic wear work great. We recommend water shoes but barefoot is fine too.

faq.question: Can I do SUP if I can't swim?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide life jackets for all paddlers. However, basic water comfort is recommended. The lake is calm and shallow near the shore.

faq.question: Is there a weight limit?
faq.answer: Our standard boards support up to 100kg comfortably. For larger paddlers, we have extra-stable boards available. Just let us know when you arrive.

eboat.title: E-Boat Rental
eboat.detailedDescription:
Our electric boats offer the perfect way to enjoy Herastrau Lake without any effort or special skills. These quiet, eco-friendly vessels are easy to operate and require no boating license, making them ideal for families, groups of friends, or romantic outings.

With space for up to 6 passengers, e-boats are perfect for celebrations, leisurely cruises, or simply enjoying the scenery. The silent electric motor lets you appreciate the peaceful atmosphere of the lake while taking in views of Herastrau Park.
eboat.longDesc: Cruise the lake in style with our quiet, eco-friendly electric boats. No boating license required - perfect for a relaxing afternoon with friends or family. Seats up to 6 people.
included: Electric boat for up to 6 people

faq.question: Do I need a boat license to rent an e-boat?
faq.answer: No license is required! Our e-boats are classified as recreational vessels that anyone can operate. We provide a brief orientation before you depart.

faq.question: How many people can fit in an e-boat?
faq.answer: Our e-boats comfortably seat up to 6 people. This makes them perfect for families or small groups of friends.

faq.question: Are the boats safe for children?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We provide life jackets in all sizes, and the boats are very stable. Children must be accompanied by adults at all times.

faq.question: How fast do the e-boats go?
faq.answer: E-boats cruise at a relaxing pace, around 6-8 km/h. They're designed for leisurely enjoyment of the lake, not speed.

faq.question: Can we bring food and drinks?
faq.answer: Yes! You're welcome to bring snacks and beverages on board. Just remember to take your trash with you when you return.

sailing.title: Sailing Boats
sailing.description: Sail the lake with our fleet
sailing.heroSubtitle: Experience the thrill of sailing on Herastrau Lake
sailing.detailedDescription:
Sailing on Herastrau Lake offers a unique and exhilarating experience right in the heart of Bucharest. Our fleet includes various sailboat types suitable for beginners learning the ropes and experienced sailors looking for a quick session on the water.

Feel the wind in your sails as you navigate the lake, enjoying a sport that combines skill, nature, and relaxation. For those new to sailing, we offer boats with instructor accompaniment to ensure a safe and educational experience.
sailing.longDesc: Experience the thrill of sailing on Herastrau Lake. Our fleet includes boats for beginners and experienced sailors. Feel the wind and enjoy a unique perspective of Bucharest.

faq.question: Do I need sailing experience?
faq.answer: For solo rentals, basic sailing knowledge is required. Beginners should book with an instructor or take our sailing lessons first. We assess skill level before rental.

faq.question: What if there's no wind?
faq.answer: Light wind days can still be enjoyable for practice and relaxation. If conditions are truly unsuitable, we'll recommend rescheduling or offer an alternative activity.

faq.question: Can I bring my own sailing gear?
faq.answer: Yes! Feel free to bring your own life jacket, gloves, or other gear. All safety equipment is also provided by us if needed.

lessons.title: Sailing Lessons
lessons.description: Learn to sail with certified instructors
lessons.detailedDescription:
Our sailing lessons are designed for anyone who wants to learn the art of sailing, from complete beginners to those looking to refine their skills. Led by certified instructors with years of experience, our lessons combine theory and hands-on practice on the water.

Whether you dream of sailing independently, want to prepare for certification, or simply wish to understand the basics, our structured program will help you achieve your goals. Small class sizes ensure personalized attention and faster progress.
lessons.longDesc: Start your sailing journey with our certified instructors. From basic boat handling to advanced techniques, we offer personalized lessons for all ages and skill levels.
lessons.pricingSubtitle: Learn to sail with the experts

faq.question: How many lessons do I need to sail alone?
faq.answer: Most students can sail independently after 5-6 lessons. Our beginner package is designed to get you to that level, covering all essential skills and safety knowledge.

faq.question: What age can children start sailing lessons?
faq.answer: We accept students from age 8 and up. Children 8-12 take specialized junior lessons with extra safety measures. Teens and adults learn together in regular classes.

faq.question: Do you offer certification?
faq.answer: Yes! After completing our full course program, students can take a practical assessment to receive a sailing competency certificate recognized for recreational sailing.

faq.question: What if I miss a lesson?
faq.answer: Package lessons can be rescheduled with 24-hour notice. We understand schedules change and work with you to find suitable alternative times.

faq.question: Can I gift sailing lessons?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Sailing lessons make a unique and memorable gift. We offer gift vouchers for single lessons or full packages.
